_doc: SLH-DSA vectors for the repo's SHA-256-only SLH-DSA variant, the one the compiled on-chain verifier and the TS/Go/Rust/Zig/Ruby/Java SDKs implement (F-133). 'accept' vectors were signed by the repo TS reference packages/runar-testing/src/crypto/slh-dsa.ts (slhKeygen/slhSign) and cross-checked at generation time: the independent PyPI slh-dsa 0.2.5 Sha2_1Parameter instantiation (SHA-256-only, FIPS 205 Table 2 dimensions) and the Ruby tier (packages/runar-rb/lib/runar/slh_dsa.rb) both ACCEPT them, while PyPI slh-dsa's real FIPS 205 parameter sets (SHA-512 for the 192/256 sets) REJECT them. The 'reject_fips_sha512' vector is a genuine FIPS 205 SLH-DSA-SHA2-192f signature (PyPI slh-dsa 0.2.5, sha2_192f, internal interface) that the repo variant must reject. SLH-DSA-SHA2-256f is not duplicated here: the test reads the on-chain-accepted witness conformance/witnesses/real-crypto/post-quantum-slhdsa-256f.json.
